High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Raghunandan Soni - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri H.S.Rathore - Public Prosecutor for the respondent
Heard on I.A No.4853/2025, which is first application under Section 430(1) of BNSS for grant of suspension of sentence filed on behalf of appellant Akash Kochle.

The appellant has been convicted under Section 363,376(3),376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo R.I for 5 years, 20 years, 10 years, 20 years with fine of Rs.500/-, Rs.1000/-, Rs.500/- , Rs.1000/- respectively with default stipulation.
As per the prosecution story, the appellant had abducted the minor girl and exploited her sexually.
Counsel for the appellant argued that the prosecutrix was a consenting party and she herself had gone with the appellant and remained with him for 14 days.
The source regarding recording of date of birth in the scholar register is not proved by the prosecution.

In the case of Tijubai @ Omvati Bai and Others Vs. State of M.P. reported in 2025(1) MPLJ (Cri.)75, it has been held that if the prosecution does not prove the source of date of birth recorded in scholar register and the same is recorded on the guess, the same cannot be the basis for conviction.

entities.text: Tijubai @ Omvati Bai and Others Vs. State of M.P. reported in 2025(1) MPLJ (Cri.)75,
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hearing of the appeal may take time.
2 CRA-3634-2025 Counsel for the State opposes the prayer.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the statement of the prosecutrix that she was a consenting party and the source of recording the age of the prosecutrix in the scholar register is not proved and the also the judgment passed in the case of Tijubai (supra).
The age of the appellant is 20 years.
The FSL is also negative, therefore, we are of the considered opinion that the appellant is entitled for grant of suspension of sentence.

The jail sentence of appellant Akash Kochle is suspended Aakash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 31 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130632255/
1 upon his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his/her appearance before the Registry of this Court on 24/6/2026 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry.
With the aforesaid, I.A is allowed and disposed of.
